findings.finding: q80 percentile method is not pinned by any committed law. SPEC §3 L73-74: 'điều kiện |m| ≥ q80(|m|, trailing-252d, strict-past) — q80 từ anatomy (NQ dossier H4 refined spec; ES §8-H5), không tune'; checked ESNQ_HYPOTHESES.md, ES/NQ_DEEPFOUR_V3_ADDENDUM.md — no interpolation method declared. Pinned here: numpy.percentile(…, 80) linear interpolation. Does not affect gate-4 criteria (enumeration/cost/determinism); MUST be ratified (owner/freeze amendment) before scored execution.

C2 direction law unstated. PLAYBOOKS L76: '(C2) always-in-RTH baseline — CÓ PnL path ⇒ scored identity'; L87 row gives only 'tier 2, cùng folds'. Implemented: unconditional LONG entry at D0 fill, hold to era-correct RTH close, no TP/SL (the only reading consistent with 'always-in'). Ratification required before gate 6.

C1 RNG algorithm unstated. PLAYBOOKS L76: '(seed cố định 20261002, sign-draw deterministic theo session)'. Pinned here: sign=+1 iff sha256('FBES1-PLA-D0-S2|seed=20261002|'+session_date).digest()[0] < 0x80 else −1. Ratification required before gate 6 (a different generator = a different placebo path).

Window fencing: q80 and SL-donor windows computed chain-wide strict-past (trailing 252 computable-|m| sessions / trailing 20 non-short-flagged sessions), NOT fold-fenced; trading itself is fold-fenced by the frozen eval windows + POSITIONAL warmup carve-out enforced for every identity. Corroboration: under fold-fenced windows the F2-F4 eval heads would have zero trades for ~20+ sessions, contradicting the frozen eval-session counts (375/950/711/890, reproduced exactly).

Cost application: all-in/side booked as USD lines at the pinned Variant-A table values (fees 2.25 or 2.24-in-NFA-window + spread 6.25 + tier slippage); fill prices unadjusted; TP/SL levels derive from the fill price per SPEC §4.

FOMCIN positional-warmup defect caught and fixed during this rehearsal: the first build traded warmup-position FOMC days (6 of 15 CONT-UP trades, e.g. 2013-03-20, 2018-01-31, 2022-01-26) because FOMC_STATEMENT_DAY has exclusion priority over WARMUP in the frozen list while the warmup carve-out is positional ('warmup 252 sessions per fold head — excluded from scoring'). Fix: FOMCIN set requires session_date > fold warmup_carve_out.last. Post-fix FOMCIN set = 104 sessions; scan confirms ZERO trades inside any warmup range across all 24 identities.
Single D0 fill-bar gap: 2020-03-16 lacks the 08:31 bar (COVID limit-down open) — deterministic no-fill skip, no imputation. All other 2,925 eval sessions fill normally.

7 eval sessions are m-unavailable (prior-session actual close or 08:30 open missing): 2012-04-09, 2012-10-31, 2015-04-06, 2021-04-05, 2023-04-10, 2025-01-10, 2026-04-06 (Easter-Monday-adjacent sessions, the 2025-01-10 mourning close, 2026 Easter Monday). E4-consistent no-signal skips.
28 eval sessions have m == 0 exactly (open_0830 print-equal to C_prev) — no direction; C4 skips them, primaries classify tail=None.

Era-close validation vs baseline chain daily columns: last-RTH-bar close matches chain 'close' on 4,142/4,204 sessions; the 51 differing sessions differ by EXACTLY 1 tick (0.25) — the chain column embeds a different final-print convention; the consumed law is the panel last print (freeze pin: panel is 'THE ES data panel consumed by every signal/fill/SL computation'). RTH-open matches 4,193/4,204. Evaluation view only; no effect on any pass criterion.
q80 tail share 553/2,926 = 18.9% (UP 289 / DN 264), consistent with the anatomy expectation '~20%' (ES_DEEPFOUR_V3_ADDENDUM L342).
